result.summary: The interface presents 2 minor issues involving placeholder assets and text layout limitations.

issues.description: The application uses generic vector illustrations instead of real food photography for restaurant listings.
issues.suggestion: Replace placeholder graphics with high-resolution food imagery to improve visual appeal and trustworthiness.

issues.description: Restaurant titles in the horizontal scroll section are truncated, hiding full business names.
issues.suggestion: Implement flexible container widths or wrap text to ensure complete restaurant names are visible.
